summary: An admin account deleted outside PIM now disappears by itself, and a few bad rows give a warning instead of a failed job.

fixes.title: Accounts deleted outside PIM finish by themselves
fixes.text: When an admin account no longer exists in Microsoft Entra ID, PIM confirms it and removes the row by itself. Delete on such an account says it is already gone.

fixes.title: Warnings instead of failed jobs for bad rows
fixes.text: A job that only meets a few rows with a missing role now ends with a warning naming those rows and what to do.
